# fabric_resources (Data Source)

Fetch the FABRIC available resources model.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `end_date` (String) Availability end time in FABRIC or RFC3339 format.
- `excludes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to exclude, such as `RENC,UKY`.
- `force_refresh` (Boolean) Whether to bypass cached resource information.
- `graph_format` (String) Portal resource graph format. When set, the provider calls the portal resources endpoint.
- `includes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to include, such as `RENC,UKY`.
- `level` (Number) Resource detail level to request from FABRIC. Defaults to `1`.
- `start_date` (String) Availability start time in FABRIC or RFC3339 format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier.
- `model` (String) Opaque resource model returned by FABRIC.
